scope: Supervised inactive-root image-copy journal and root-only device wrapper. Temporary regular-file fixtures exercise the shared ext4 writer and restart behavior. No installed Pi partition has been written and no boot trial is authorized.

ext4.filesystem_scope: Host /home/data ext4, reported as ext2/ext3 by statfs; private regular-file targets and journals.

pi5_validation.scope: UID 1000, temporary regular-file targets under /tmp; actual command entry-point refusal before private installed paths are opened. Elapsed test duration is not an installation benchmark.

covered_cases: Initial inactive bytes must match the preserved original digest before writing intent is committed.
Exact compressed/expanded content, actual ext4 filesystem and embedded image identity; unused partition tail retained.
Errors at every reported progress boundary; explicit resume from writing and read-only revalidation from written.
Actual child _exit(86) without destructors after intent, device-flush simulation and written-journal publication.
Write/partial-write, flush, readback, filesystem-check, identity and checker-mutation failures do not publish written.
Altered originals or completed targets, changed backup binding, bad payloads and corrupt journals are refused.
Incomplete pending record never replaces published authority; unsafe links, concurrent transaction and revoked guard are rejected.
Quiescence still rejects runtime threads and legacy helpers when an installer target is specified.
Existing signed-OTA writer tests remain passing; bootstrap creates no VerifiedCandidate or production RecoveryRecord.
live_checks_not_performed: Root-only bootstrap admission against an installed Pi, independent recovery exports and restore rehearsal.
Positive real-device test of the own-target /proc descriptor exception, exclusive block claim and device ioctls.
Physical interruption, power loss, firmware tryboot, watchdog expiry/handoff or successful normal/trial boot.
Independent fresh root/runtime SSH logins and complete effective privilege audit after actual migration.
remaining: Root connection details for both Pis and supervised live preservation, exports, access qualification and inactive-root installation.
Durable boot-asset staging and trial-selector publication, bootstrap health/persistent-store checks and watchdog handoff.
Staged normal and canonical normal boot confirmation followed by explicit recovery-baseline provisioning.
Physical Pi 4/5 failure qualification and end-to-end feed, updater, maintenance holds, scheduling and UI integration.
